title: Formal correspondence
goal: Write a clear professional email to a client or partner: a precise subject line, the right greeting and closing for Canada or France, and a standard formula for each paragraph.

items.fr: objet → appel → contexte → demande → disponibilité → salutation
items.en: the structure of a professional email

drills.text: ___ faire suite à notre rencontre de mardi, je vous confirme la date de livraison.
drills.en: Following up on our meeting on Tuesday, I'm confirming the delivery date.
drills.explain: The first paragraph links the email to what came before: [[Pour faire suite à…]].

drills.prompt: Which sentence belongs in the last paragraph, just before the closing?
options: Je reste à votre disposition pour tout renseignement complémentaire.
Pour faire suite à votre appel, je vous écris.
drills.explain: Offering further help is the classic last sentence before [[Cordialement]] or [[Salutations]].

drills.en: Please find the detailed schedule attached.
drills.explain: [[ci-joint]] = attached. It usually stays invariable here, before the noun it introduces and at the start of a sentence.

items.fr: Pour faire suite à notre échange, …
items.en: Following up on our conversation, … (email opening)
accept: À la suite de notre échange, …
items.note: [[Suite à]] is very common in emails, but careful writers prefer [[pour faire suite à]] or [[à la suite de]].

items.fr: Je me permets de vous relancer au sujet de…
items.en: I'm following up on… (polite reminder when there's no reply)
accept: Je me permets de vous relancer concernant…
Je vous relance au sujet de…

items.fr: Je reste à votre disposition pour tout renseignement complémentaire.
items.en: I remain available should you need any further information.
accept: Je demeure à votre disposition pour tout renseignement complémentaire.

example.en: I acknowledge receipt of your email.

items.fr: Je vous remercie par avance de votre retour.
items.en: Thank you in advance for your reply. (formal)
accept: Je vous remercie à l'avance de votre retour.
Je vous remercie d'avance de votre retour.
Merci par avance de votre retour.
items.note: In Québec you will often see [[à l'avance]]; in France, [[par avance]] or [[d'avance]].
Common in Québec emails, often shortened to [[Salutations]].

example.fr: Je mets mon collègue Olivier en copie.
Afin de respecter ce délai, nous avons besoin de vos commentaires.
example.en: In order to meet this deadline, we need your comments.

example.fr: Pourriez-vous nous faire parvenir votre devis ?
example.en: Could you send us your quote?

items.note: In Québec, people also say [[une soumission]].

steps.title: Three emails, three registers
steps.intro: At B1 you wrote short emails to your team. Now Raj, who coordinates projects at a software company in Montréal, writes to people **outside** the company. Read his emails and notice what changes between Québec and France.

blocks.title: 1. To a client in Québec
blocks.context: Raj confirms a delivery date to Nathalie Gagnon, a client at a credit union.
blocks.fr:
Objet : Suivi de notre rencontre – livraison de votre application le 14 mars

Bonjour Madame Gagnon,

Pour faire suite à notre rencontre de mardi, je vous confirme que la nouvelle version de votre application sera livrée le 14 mars, comme prévu. Vous trouverez ci-joint le calendrier détaillé ainsi que la liste des fonctionnalités incluses.

Afin de respecter ce délai, nous aurions besoin de recevoir vos commentaires sur les maquettes au plus tard le 7 mars. Pourriez-vous les transmettre à mon collègue Olivier Roy, que je mets en copie ?

Je reste à votre disposition pour tout renseignement complémentaire.

Merci et bonne journée,

Raj Patel
Coordonnateur de projets, Logiciels Boréal
blocks.en:
Subject: Follow-up to our meeting – delivery of your app on March 14

Hello Ms. Gagnon,

Following up on our meeting on Tuesday, I'm confirming that the new version of your app will be delivered on March 14, as planned. Please find attached the detailed schedule as well as the list of included features.

In order to meet this deadline, we would need to receive your comments on the mock-ups by March 7 at the latest. Could you send them to my colleague Olivier Roy, whom I'm copying?

I remain available should you need any further information.

Thanks and have a good day,

Raj Patel
Project Coordinator, Logiciels Boréal

blocks.title: 2. The client's reply
blocks.fr:
Bonjour Monsieur Patel,

J'accuse réception du calendrier et je vous remercie de ces précisions. Nous vous enverrons nos commentaires d'ici le 6 mars.

Bien à vous,

Nathalie Gagnon
blocks.en:
Hello Mr. Patel,

I acknowledge receipt of the schedule and thank you for these details. We will send you our comments by March 6.

Best regards,

Nathalie Gagnon

blocks.title: 3. A reminder to a partner in France
blocks.context: Two weeks ago, Raj asked a translation agency in Lyon for a quote. No answer yet.
blocks.fr:
Objet : Relance – devis pour la traduction du guide utilisateur

Monsieur,

Je me permets de vous relancer au sujet de notre demande de devis du 2 février concernant la traduction de notre guide utilisateur. Sauf erreur de ma part, nous n'avons pas encore reçu votre proposition.

Notre client souhaite lancer la version européenne en avril ; nous devons donc choisir un prestataire dans les meilleurs délais. Pourriez-vous nous faire parvenir votre devis d'ici la fin de la semaine ?

Je vous remercie par avance de votre retour.

Cordialement,

Raj Patel
blocks.en:
Subject: Reminder – quote for the translation of the user guide

Dear Sir,

I'm following up on our request for a quote of February 2 regarding the translation of our user guide. Unless I'm mistaken, we have not yet received your proposal.

Our client wants to launch the European version in April; we therefore need to choose a supplier as soon as possible. Could you send us your quote by the end of the week?

Thank you in advance for your reply.

Kind regards,

Raj Patel

blocks.prompt: Why does Raj write “Sauf erreur de ma part” in the third email?
options: To make the reminder less accusing
To apologize for a mistake he made
To say the quote was wrong
blocks.explain: [[Sauf erreur de ma part]] (unless I'm mistaken) leaves room for the possibility that the quote was sent: the reminder sounds polite, not accusing.

blocks.prompt: What is different about the greeting in the email to France?
options: It uses only “Monsieur,” without “Bonjour” or a name
blocks.explain: In France, the most formal greeting is just [[Monsieur,]] or [[Madame,]]. In Québec emails, [[Bonjour Madame Gagnon,]] with the surname is common and polite. These are tendencies, not strict rules.

steps.title: The professional email, part by part

blocks.title: Anatomy of a professional email
head: Part
What it does
Example
rows: Says exactly what the email is about (topic + date or action)
Greets the reader at the right level
Pour faire suite à notre rencontre de mardi, …
Je vous confirme que… Vous trouverez ci-joint…
Asks for one clear action, with a date
Closes at the same level as the greeting
blocks.note: One idea per paragraph, short sentences, and the request **in its own paragraph** with a deadline. A busy reader should understand the email from the subject line and the first two lines.

blocks.title: Greetings: Québec and France
head: Situation
In Québec / Canada
In France
rows: You don't know who will read it
Bonjour à tous, / Bonjour à toutes et à tous,
blocks.note: In France, traditional usage avoids the surname after [[Madame]] or [[Monsieur]] ([[Bonjour Madame Dupont]] is spreading in emails, but many readers still find it less formal). In Québec emails, using the surname is common and polite. Treat both as tendencies: follow what your correspondent does.

blocks.title: Closings, from most to least formal
head: Closing
When to use it
rows: Veuillez agréer, Madame, mes salutations distinguées.
Formal emails, very common in Québec
The standard professional email closing everywhere
Merci et bonne journée, / Au plaisir,
blocks.note: Match the closing to the greeting: [[Madame,]] at the top and [[Merci !]] at the bottom don't go together.

blocks.title: One formula per paragraph
blocks.note: Learn one or two formulas for each slot and you can write almost any professional email.

examples.fr: Pour faire suite à notre échange téléphonique, je vous envoie le contrat.
examples.en: Following up on our phone conversation, I'm sending you the contract.

examples.fr: Je me permets de vous relancer au sujet de ma demande du 2 février.
examples.en: I'm following up on my request of February 2.

examples.fr: Je vous confirme que la réunion aura lieu le jeudi 12 juin à 10 h.
examples.en: I'm confirming that the meeting will take place on Thursday, June 12 at 10 a.m.

examples.fr: Pourriez-vous nous faire parvenir votre devis dans les meilleurs délais ?
examples.en: Could you send us your quote as soon as possible?

examples.fr: N'hésitez pas à me contacter si vous avez des questions.
examples.en: Don't hesitate to contact me if you have any questions.

blocks.title: Formulas and words for this lesson
Québec office French
blocks.body:
- **[[courriel]]** is the standard word in Canada (the Office québécois de la langue française recommends it). In France, people say [[mail]] or [[e-mail]] at work, and [[courriel]] in official texts. Spam is [[un pourriel]] in Québec.
- **[[une rencontre]]** often means a work meeting in Québec ([[notre rencontre de mardi]]). In France, a work meeting is [[une réunion]]; [[une rencontre]] is more a meeting with someone.
- **[[coordonnateur]]** is the usual Québec title; France says [[coordinateur]].
- **[[c. c.]]** (copie conforme) is the Québec abbreviation for cc. [[Je vous mets en copie]] works everywhere.
- **[[Au plaisir,]]** and **[[Merci et bonne journée,]]** are friendly closings you'll see constantly in Québec, even with clients you know a little.
- Abbreviations: [[M.]] for Monsieur, [[Mme]] for Madame (no period). Never [[Mr]] in French. In the greeting itself, write [[Madame]] or [[Monsieur]] in full.

blocks.title: Traps in professional emails
blocks.body:
- **Calques from English:** [[J'espère que ce courriel vous trouve bien]] ✗ (from “I hope this email finds you well”). If you want a friendly opening, write [[J'espère que vous allez bien.]] Better still, go straight to the point.
- **[[Cher Monsieur Gagnon]]** ✗ for a first contact. [[Cher / Chère]] suggests an existing relationship; with a stranger it sounds odd. Use [[Bonjour Monsieur Gagnon,]] (Québec) or [[Monsieur,]] (France).
- **[[délai]] ≠ delay.** [[Le délai est le 7 mars]] = the deadline is March 7. A delay is [[un retard]].
- **A vague subject line:** [[Objet : Question]] ✗ → [[Objet : Question sur la facture no 2541]] ✓
- **[[Merci d'avance]] alone** can sound like pressure: the reader hasn't agreed yet. In formal emails, write the full sentence: [[Je vous remercie par avance de votre retour.]]
- **Mixing registers:** [[Madame,]] at the top and [[À plus !]] at the bottom. Choose one level and keep it.
- **[[Cordialement vôtre]]** is dated; just write [[Cordialement,]].

blocks.title: Why so many formulas?
blocks.body: French professional writing is more ritual than English. Readers expect certain formulas in certain places, and their absence feels abrupt, not efficient. A sentence like [[Pourriez-vous m'envoyer le devis ?]] is fine, but wrapped in [[Je me permets de…]] and [[Je vous remercie par avance…]], the same request reads as competent and respectful. The good news: because the formulas are fixed, you can learn them as blocks and reuse them for years.

blocks.title: Listen and repeat
blocks.note: These formulas are also useful on the phone and in voicemails. Say them as one smooth block.

lines.fr: Pour faire suite à notre échange, je vous envoie le contrat.
lines.en: Following up on our conversation, I'm sending you the contract.

lines.fr: Je me permets de vous relancer au sujet de ma demande.
lines.en: I'm following up on my request.

lines.fr: Sauf erreur de ma part, nous n'avons pas reçu votre réponse.
lines.en: Unless I'm mistaken, we haven't received your answer.

lines.fr: Je reste à votre disposition pour tout renseignement complémentaire.
lines.en: I remain available should you need any further information.

lines.fr: Je vous remercie par avance de votre retour.
lines.en: Thank you in advance for your reply.

blocks.fr: Bonjour Monsieur Tremblay, ici Raj Patel, de Logiciels Boréal. Je me permets de vous rappeler au sujet du contrat. Sauf erreur de ma part, nous n'avons pas encore reçu la version signée. Pourriez-vous me rappeler dans les meilleurs délais ? Merci et bonne journée.
blocks.en: Hello Mr. Tremblay, this is Raj Patel from Logiciels Boréal. I'm calling you back about the contract. Unless I'm mistaken, we haven't received the signed version yet. Could you call me back as soon as possible? Thanks and have a good day.
blocks.explain: [[nous n'avons pas encore reçu la version signée]]: the signed version of the contract.

blocks.fr: Je vous confirme que la formation aura lieu le jeudi 12 juin à 9 h 30. Vous trouverez le programme en pièce jointe. Je mets ma collègue Amira en copie.
blocks.en: I'm confirming that the training will take place on Thursday, June 12 at 9:30. You'll find the program attached. I'm copying my colleague Amira.
blocks.explain: [[Je mets ma collègue Amira en copie]] = I'm cc'ing my colleague Amira.

steps.title: Your turn
steps.intro: Answer without scrolling back. Some questions bring back B1 formal letters and pronouns.

blocks.prompt: You're writing for the first time to a client in Québec, Nathalie Gagnon. Which greeting is best?
optionFeedback: Far too familiar for a first contact with a client.
[[Chère]] implies an existing relationship, and the full name sounds odd.
Write [[Madame]] in full, and use the surname, not the first name.

blocks.text: ___ erreur de ma part, nous n'avons pas encore reçu votre ___.
blocks.en: Unless I'm mistaken, we haven't received your quote yet.
blocks.explain: [[Sauf erreur de ma part]] softens a reminder. [[Le devis]] (or [[la soumission]] in Québec) is a quote.

blocks.prompt: Please find attached the detailed schedule. (formal email)
accept: Vous trouverez ci-joint le calendrier détaillé.
Veuillez trouver ci-joint le calendrier détaillé.
Ci-joint, vous trouverez le calendrier détaillé.
Vous trouverez en pièce jointe le calendrier détaillé.
Veuillez trouver en pièce jointe le calendrier détaillé.
Vous trouverez le calendrier détaillé en pièce jointe.
blocks.explain: [[Vous trouverez ci-joint…]] is the most natural formula; [[en pièce jointe]] works too.

blocks.prompt: Match each closing to the best situation.
pairs: Veuillez agréer, Monsieur, mes salutations distinguées.

blocks.text: Je reste à votre ___ pour tout renseignement ___.
blocks.en: I remain available should you need any further information.
blocks.explain: A fixed formula: learn it as one block.

blocks.prompt: I'm following up on my request. (formal)
accept: Je vous relance concernant ma demande
blocks.explain: [[relancer quelqu'un]] = to remind or chase someone politely. The pronoun [[vous]] goes before the verb.

blocks.prompt: I acknowledge receipt of your email.
blocks.explain: [[accuser réception de]] has nothing to do with accusing: it means to confirm you received something.

blocks.text: Pourriez-vous ___ transmettre à Olivier, que je mets en ___ ?
blocks.en: Could you send them to Olivier, whom I'm copying?
blocks.explain: [[les]] replaces [[vos commentaires]] (A2 pronouns, before the infinitive). [[mettre en copie]] = to cc.

blocks.fr: Je vous remercie par avance de votre retour.
blocks.explain: [[par avance]] (France) or [[à l'avance]] (Québec); [[votre retour]] = your reply or feedback.

blocks.prompt: Which subject line is the most useful?
options: Objet : Relance – facture no 2541 du 3 mars
blocks.explain: A good [[objet]] gives the topic and a reference: the reader knows what to do before opening the email.

blocks.prompt: You work for a company in Gatineau. Write to M. Alain Tremblay, a client: confirm the date and time of next week's meeting, say the agenda is attached, ask him to send a document before a date, and close politely. Use Québec conventions.
blocks.promptFr: Écrivez un courriel à M. Tremblay pour confirmer la rencontre.
checklist: A context opening (Pour faire suite à…)
One clear request with a date (Pourriez-vous… d'ici le… ?)
A closing that matches the greeting, and a signature

models.label: Model answer
models.fr:
Objet : Confirmation – rencontre du mardi 18 novembre

Bonjour Monsieur Tremblay,

Pour faire suite à notre appel de ce matin, je vous confirme que notre rencontre aura lieu le mardi 18 novembre à 14 h, dans nos bureaux de Gatineau. Vous trouverez ci-joint l'ordre du jour.

Afin de bien préparer cette rencontre, pourriez-vous nous faire parvenir le rapport financier de votre service d'ici le vendredi 14 novembre ?

Je reste à votre disposition pour tout renseignement complémentaire.

Salutations,

Karim Benali
Conseiller principal, Groupe Outaouais Conseil
models.en:
Subject: Confirmation – meeting on Tuesday, November 18

Hello Mr. Tremblay,

Following up on our call this morning, I'm confirming that our meeting will take place on Tuesday, November 18 at 2 p.m., in our Gatineau offices. Please find the agenda attached.

In order to prepare this meeting well, could you send us your department's financial report by Friday, November 14?

I remain available should you need any further information.

Regards,

Karim Benali
Senior Advisor, Groupe Outaouais Conseil

blocks.prompt: Leave a professional voicemail for a supplier who hasn't sent a quote: say who you are and your company, the reason for your call, a softened reminder, a request with a deadline, and a polite closing.
checklist: Je me permets de vous rappeler au sujet de…

models.label: Model answer
models.fr: Bonjour Madame Lefebvre, ici Mei Chen, de la clinique Saint-Laurent. Je me permets de vous rappeler au sujet de notre demande de devis pour les nouveaux ordinateurs. Sauf erreur de ma part, nous n'avons pas encore reçu votre proposition. Pourriez-vous nous l'envoyer d'ici jeudi ? Vous pouvez me joindre au bureau toute la journée. Merci et bonne journée !
models.en: Hello Ms. Lefebvre, this is Mei Chen from the Saint-Laurent clinic. I'm calling you back about our request for a quote for the new computers. Unless I'm mistaken, we haven't received your proposal yet. Could you send it to us by Thursday? You can reach me at the office all day. Thanks and have a good day!

summary:
- Build a professional email: precise [[objet]], greeting, context, message, request with a date, offer of help, closing
- Choose the right greeting and closing for Québec ([[Bonjour Madame Gagnon,]] [[Salutations,]]) or France ([[Madame,]] [[Cordialement,]])
- Use key formulas: [[Pour faire suite à…]], [[Je me permets de vous relancer…]], [[sauf erreur de ma part]], [[Je reste à votre disposition…]]
- Avoid false friends and calques: [[délai]] = deadline, not *delay*

meta.author: ai
meta.notes: Hedged the Québec/France greeting conventions as tendencies; corrected the ci-joint rule; removed a non-homophone dictation answer (à l'avance) and a reorder distractor that allowed a defensible alternative.
